top_news.title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
top_news.dek: NCP-ArchPreview introduces Next Concept Prediction to improve language model pretraining by learning discrete concepts alongside standard token prediction.
top_news.brief: The Intern-NCP team released a technical report on NCP-ArchPreview, a latent-space language model. It combines standard next-token prediction with a concept-level objective, forcing the model to learn discrete concepts that span multiple tokens. This approach aims to enhance structural understanding while maintaining autoregressive generation capabilities.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual diagram of latent space language model architecture

top_news.title: OpenAI Agents API
top_news.dek: OpenAI has launched an Agents API, enabling developers to build autonomous agents with native code execution and sub-agent orchestration.
top_news.brief: The new API provides a framework for creating agents capable of executing code and managing sub-tasks. This release aims to standardize the development of autonomous workflows, allowing for more complex, multi-step reasoning and tool interaction within the OpenAI ecosystem.

top_news.title: How LinkedIn Trains AI Job Search 8x Faster with Multi-Teacher Distillation
top_news.dek: LinkedIn optimized its job search ranking by using multi-teacher distillation to compress large models into a compact 0.6B-parameter model.
top_news.brief: LinkedIn's new training pipeline uses multi-teacher distillation to transfer knowledge from larger models into a smaller, more efficient 0.6B-parameter ranking model. This approach significantly accelerates training times while maintaining search performance.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing multi-teacher distillation process for model compression

top_news.title: AI Search - AI Search supports extensionless R2 objects with Content-Type metadata
top_news.dek: Cloudflare AI Search now supports indexing R2 objects that lack file extensions, provided they include valid Content-Type metadata.
top_news.brief: Developers can now index R2 objects without filename extensions in AI Search. The system relies on Content-Type metadata to validate file types during the indexing process, allowing for more flexible object storage naming conventions.

top_news.title: Meet Redis LangCache: A Managed Semantic Cache That Cuts LLM API Costs by Up to 90% and Returns Cache Hits Up to 15x Faster
top_news.dek: Redis LangCache is a new managed semantic caching service designed to reduce LLM API costs and latency for repetitive queries.
top_news.brief: Redis LangCache acts as a semantic layer between applications and LLM APIs. By caching responses based on intent rather than exact string matches, it aims to reduce redundant API calls by up to 90% and improve response times for common queries.

primary.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now offers prefix-aware routing, a routing strategy that sends requests sharing the same prompt prefix to the same instance so the KV cache stays warm. In benchmarks on Llama 3.1 70B, it reduced P50 time-to-first-token by up to 77% and raised KV cache hit rates from about 25% to over 80%.
